node.statement: Under the global-scalar producer hypotheses with target ambient defect epsilon_A<=t<=W.r_reset, lem-maincb-initial-raw-inclusion applies because t<=e_0 and furnishes u_0(lambda)=lambda*I_A as an extended D_0*t-inclusion. Since D_0*t<=D_*t, lem-maincb-extended-inclusion-monotone makes this same map with the same amplification family an extended D_*t-inclusion. Moreover u_0(I_C)=I_A exactly, so ||u_0(I_C)-I_A||=0<=D_*t.
